# Rocketlane

Collaborative customer onboarding and implementation platform for professional services teams.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rocketlane/.

## Actions

- **Create Company**: Creates a new company (account) in rocketlane.
- **Create Time Entry**: Create a new time entry in rocketlane.
- **Delete Project**: This tool allows users to permanently delete a project in rocketlane.
- **Get Company** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific company/account in rocketlane by its id.
- **Get Time Entries** (read-only): Retrieve all time entries from rocketlane.
- **List Companies** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all companies/accounts in rocketlane.
- **List Company Fields** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available company/account fields in rocketlane.
- **List Company Note Fields** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available note fields for companies in rocketlane.
- **List Currencies** (read-only): Returns a predefined list of commonly used currencies since rocketlane api doesn't provide a dedicated currencies endpoint.
- **List Project Fields** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all project fields in rocketlane, including both default and custom fields.
- **List Project Phases** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of project phases from rocketlane.
- **List Projects** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all projects in the rocketlane instance.
- **List Task Fields** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all task fields in rocketlane.
- **List Templates** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available templates in rocketlane.
- **List Users** (read-only): This tool retrieves all users in the rocketlane instance.
- **Update Company**: This tool updates an existing company/account in rocketlane.
- **Archive Project by ID**: Archives a specific project based on its unique identifier.
- **Create Task**: Creates a new task.
- **Delete Task By ID**: Delete a specific task using its unique identifier (taskid).
- **Delete Time Entry by ID**: Delete a specific time entry using its unique identifier (timeentryid).
- **Get All Fields**: Retrieve all custom fields available in the system.
- **Get Field By ID**: Retrieve detailed information about a specific custom field using its unique identifier (fieldid).
- **Get Project by ID**: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project using its unique identifier.
- **Get Task By Id**: Retrieve extensive information about a specific task using the task's unique identifier (taskid).
- **Get Template By ID**: Retrieve detailed information about a specific template using its unique identifier (templateid).
- **Get Time Entry By ID**: Retrieve detailed information about a specific time entry using its unique identifier (timeentryid).
- **Get User By ID**: Retrieve detailed information about a specific user using their unique identifier (userid).
- **List Customer Users**: List customer users.
- **List Vendor Users** (read-only): List vendor users by filtering users with type 'partner'.
- **Retrieve Subscription Details**: Retrieves detailed information about the current subscription.
- **Search User By Email**: Search user by email id.
- **Update Project By Id**: Updates an existing project's details using its unique identifier.
- **Update Time Entry by ID**: Update existing time entry details using its unique identifier (timeentryid).
